name: My Netorase Delusions
source: My Netorase Delusions is a visual novel about an office worker who feels his sex life has become monotonous and boring… until he discovers the cuckold fetish. A story where you’ll share the most important person in your life, your wife, with other men of your choosing: Mike, a strong and dominant man, or Haru, a shy and delicate femboy!
